contradictory_evidence: Popular heroic retellings can present one clean civilizational clash; the succession dispute inside Morocco and Abd al-Malik's prior Ottoman support make the alignments more complex.
A nationalist reading can describe 1578 as the sole cause of Portuguese decline; Portugal's succession, finance, empire, and the 1580 dynastic union require separate evidence.
Numbers for army size and casualties vary across later narratives; none should enter the edition as FACT until a citable edition of a source and modern scholarly comparison are checked.
uncertainty: High on disputed troop/casualty numbers and motives; medium on causal interpretation; low on date, place, principal rulers and succession. Hosted live retrieval failed, so publication must explicitly call this dated context and leave unverified details UNKNOWN.
